queries.model:
[later_ordered_components = Store(K(Int, 0), 0, 1),
 original_ordered_components = Store(K(Int, 1), 0, 0),
 later_field_values = Store(K(Int, 3), 0, 2),
 original_field_values = Store(K(Int, 3), 0, 2),
 later_width = 2,
 original_width = 2]

[qualified_type = 3,
 later_normalized_key_material = K(Int, 6),
 stable_key_id = 4,
 later_width = 2,
 original_width = 1,
 original_normalized_key_material = K(Int, 6),
 k!3 = [else -> 6],
 stable_deterministic_encoder = [(3, 4, 2, as-array) -> 6,
                                 else -> 5]]

scope: Unbounded positive ordered-key widths, opaque qualified component references and typed canonical values. Stable original width/order/frame plus preserved selected values imply key-vector and stable deterministic encoder equality.
limitations: Second obligation uses equal normalized finite key material as the first obligation's component-equivalence lemma; normalization outside width and construction/refinement are not derived
Integer symbols abstract qualified references and full typed literals; no hash-collision or native domain inference
No injectivity/byte-format, original UMF encoder, JSON/Python/SQL capture or browser refinement theorem
Ordinal counter only demonstrates that replacing original key material by constant row position permits distinct-key collision; no SQL row-order theorem
No authenticated issuer/mapping, complete source/role/config cut, protected evaluation or final disclosure admission
